description: This file defines the AWS GlacierClient class, a PHP SDK client for interacting with Amazon Glacier service, including middleware setup, command customization, and API documentation filtering.

classes.name: GlacierClient
classes.description: A PHP SDK client for Amazon Glacier, extending AwsClient, with middleware for checksum, API version, and source file handling.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the GlacierClient, sets up middleware for API version, checksums, content type, and source file.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Overrides parent method to set default accountId to '-' for all operations.

methods.name: getChecksumsMiddleware
methods.description: Creates middleware to add checksum headers for upload operations, throws exception if body is not seekable.

methods.name: getApiVersionMiddleware
methods.description: Creates middleware to add API version header to requests.

methods.name: applyDocFilters
methods.description: Static method to modify API documentation and shapes, adding parameters like SourceFile and ContentSHA256, and making accountId optional.
